title: Pylon — Fwd Mount Side Link — Installation of the Steel Fitting and Four-Bolt Pattern
abstract: Retrofit of the high-strength steel side link fitting and its four-bolt pattern at the forward engine mount, lifting the tracked life limit from 24 000 to 60 000 flight cycles on delivered aircraft.

sections.planning_reason: Fourteen forward mount side link fittings were replaced across the fleet in four years, eleven of them found during an engine shop visit with the aircraft already committed to a return-to-service date. The 24 000 flight cycle life limit that came with the earlier aluminium standard was forcing pylon work on a counter that matched neither the airframe nor the engine. The steel fitting substantiates to 60 000 flight cycles and replaces the strip inspection of the lug bore with a general visual check.
sections.description: The aluminium side link fitting is removed and replaced by a high-strength steel item attaching through a four-bolt pattern instead of three, with the load spread across a wider footprint on the pylon primary structure. The pylon interface plate is replaced, the inboard lug is re-machined to the new bolt spacing and a new cleat picks up the additional fastener. The new bolt pattern is drilled with a jig and every hole is inspected before the fitting is installed.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove the engine to the procedure in the maintenance documentation and support the pylon. Remove the pylon fairings to get access in zones 431 and 443. Do the removal steps of task AMM-M-54-50-12-000-004-A and take out the existing side link fitting. Remove the interface plate and clean the pylon primary structure faying surface. Set the drill jig on the two existing datum holes and drill the four-bolt pattern. Do an eddy current inspection of each new hole and record the result. Install the interface plate D5450124639244, the re-machined lug D5450125058936 and the new cleat CID666183-16. Install the steel side link fitting and torque the joint in the sequence given in the accomplishment instructions. Relocate the link support handle 1756PP 40 mm outboard. Do the installation task AMM-M-54-50-12-400-004-A, refit the fairings with screws AES177340K7 and install the engine. Do an engine ground run and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to MRD-42K1 and MRD-46K1 aircraft from MSN M00001 through M00248 that are still pre MOD-162044. Aircraft from the production cut-in onward already carry the steel fitting. Once the pylon has been drilled to the four-bolt pattern the earlier fitting can never be reinstalled, so the embodiment is one way only.
sections.material_note: Kit K5450-1033-01 contains the two steel fittings, the interface plates, the cleats and the fastener set for one aircraft. Lead time is twenty-four weeks and the fittings are the long-lead item. The removed aluminium fittings must be returned to Aeralis for the fleet fatigue survey.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next engine removal, or before the fitting reaches 24 000 flight cycles, whichever occurs first.
